titleText.es: Se necesitan voluntarios para estudio sobre la transmisión del urushiol mediante el contacto dactilar con tiras delgadas de pulpa de fibras de celulosa.
titleText.en: Volunteers needed for a study on transmission of urushiol from digital contact with thin strips of fibrous cellulose pulp.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish and English texts are the exact title attributes from the Spanish archive and official xkcd. Both turn contact with the flyer strips into the subject of another suspicious study; Vision also misread torn-paper artwork as the word ‘Mary,’ which is not printed text.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: are needed; are required (with passive se)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Necesitan is a present plural form of necesitar. In se necesitan, the plural ending agrees with the people or things that are needed, while the person doing the needing is left unnamed.
A voluntario offers to take part without being forced. The feminine plural is voluntarias.

example.en: They are looking for volunteers for the project.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Estudio can mean the act of studying, a research investigation, or a studio. A scientific or participant context points to the research meaning.

example.es: El hospital publicó un estudio nuevo.
example.en: The hospital published a new study.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Científico describes something related to science. Its ending changes to match the noun: científica, científicos, or científicas.
Investiga is the present form of investigar used with one other person or thing, or as the informal singular command.
Before a dictionary-form verb, sabe says that one person or group has the knowledge or skill to do that action. Spanish does not add cómo in this pattern.
Distinguir means recognizing the difference between people, things, or ideas.

example.es: No puedo distinguir las dos voces.
example.en: I cannot tell the two voices apart.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Estudios is the plural of estudio. In a scientific context it names research investigations rather than schoolwork or studios.
Científicos ends in -os to agree with a masculine plural noun.
Una estafa is a dishonest scheme intended to take money, property, or some other benefit from someone.

example.es: El mensaje advierte sobre estafas por internet.
example.en: The message warns about online scams.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Cosechar normally means gathering a crop. It can also be used grimly for collecting organs or figuratively for obtaining results.

example.es: Van a cosechar las uvas mañana.
example.en: They are going to harvest the grapes tomorrow.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Riñones is the plural of riñón, one of the organs that filter waste from the blood.

example.es: Los riñones forman parte del sistema urinario.
example.en: The kidneys are part of the urinary system.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Adultos can name adult men or a mixed group of adults. The feminine plural is adultas.
Sanos ends in -os to describe a masculine or mixed plural group. The singular forms are sano and sana.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that someone knows how to perform an action?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use the matching form of saber followed directly by the action verb in its unchanged dictionary form.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Spanish does not insert cómo in this pattern: sé cocinar, sabe conducir, and sabemos distinguir. Saber changes for the person and time; the following -ar, -er, or -ir verb stays unchanged.

example.en: They know how to repair bicycles.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: entre + opción A + y + opción B
cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you name the two people, things, or groups being distinguished or compared?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Place entre before the first one and y before the second one.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Entre marks the range or pair involved, and y joins its two sides. Each side may be a single word or a longer noun group.

example.es: No veo la diferencia entre el azul oscuro y el negro.
example.en: I do not see the difference between dark blue and black.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why is the volunteer flyer itself part of the joke?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: It claims to test whether people can recognize a study or a kidney-harvesting scam, while recruiting exactly the healthy type-O adults such a scam would target.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The tear-off recruitment format makes taking a strip part of the implied test. The title text adds a second mock hazard study about urushiol transmission through finger contact with thin cellulose strips. Urushiol is the oily substance associated with poison ivy and related plants, and contaminated objects can carry it after contact.

applications.explanationEn: Científico follows estudio and classifies what kind of study is meant.
Científico uses masculine singular -o to agree with estudio.
Estudio científico names the thing being described, que links it to the added information, and investiga supplies that information.
Investiga introduces the inquiry, and unaccented si opens the question whose answer could be yes or no.
Sabe changes for the group treated as singular gente, while distinguir stays in its unchanged -ir form.

applications.exampleEs: ENTRE LOS ESTUDIOS CIENTÍFICOS Y LAS ESTAFAS
applications.explanationEn: Entre starts the first group, and y introduces the second group being distinguished from it.
Científicos follows estudios and classifies what kind of studies are meant.
Científicos uses masculine plural -os to agree with estudios.
Para introduces the purpose, and cosechar stays in its unchanged -ar form.
